messages:
Maya: Quick ask — can we spin up a one-page brief for field + webinar follow-up that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private specifically for security-conscious buyers? Short, skimmable, and includes recommended talking points and a tiny benchmark nugget. Need draft by EOD Wed.

Jorge: Got it. I can draft the deployment matrix and SLAs section.

Priya: I can do the messaging bullets and the webinar CTA. Want the brief to call out fallback policies and observability perks.

Sam: For the benchmark nugget: 99th perc latency numbers for a 4k seq on medium model + cost per 1M tokens for each deploy mode. I have numbers from last run, will paste.

Sam: ````
Hosted: 99th 120ms, cost ~$8 / 1M tokens
Dedicated: 99th 90ms, cost ~$6 / 1M tokens (reserved GPU amortized)
Private: 99th 95ms, cost ~$6.5 / 1M tokens (varies by infra)
````

Aditi: Nice. Add a single line about encryption & KMS integration per deploy mode and an ops bullet for audit logs retention. Buyers always ask.

Maya: Agreed — include: encryption at rest, KMS/HSM support, and SOC2/ISO blurb. Keep language non-technical for exec summary, but include an appendix line with config hints.

Jorge: Draft skeleton below — will flesh out.

Jorge: ````
- 1-line value prop (what problem we solve)
- Quick comparison table (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — latency, cost, control, SLAs, compliance
- Security & governance: encryption, KMS, audit logs, network modes
- Ops & reliability: fallback models, routing policies, canary rollouts, tracing
- Benchmark highlight: 99th latency + cost per 1M tokens (short note on test conditions)
- Field talking points (elevator + technical + procurement)
- CTA: webinar invite link / demo booking
````

Priya: For field talking points, propose 3 elevator lines:
- Exec: "Predictable inference economics at any scale — pick hosted simplicity or private control."
- Platform lead: "Unified API across deploy modes keeps dev velocity + consistent SLAs."
- Security buyer: "Private deployment with KMS/HSM and audit trails for regulated workloads."

Aditi: Add procurement note: pricing options (pay-as-you-go hosted, reserved monthly for Dedicated, license + support for Private).

Maya: Love it. Keep visuals simple: small 3-column table + one mini bar chart for latency/cost. We can hand off to design after draft.

Priya: I'll draft language and CTA. Who owns the webinar follow-up bundle?

Sam: I'll attach the test config in the appendix we can paste into the one-pager as a one-line footnote.

Sam: ````
Test config: medium-4k model, sequence=4096, batch target=32, synthetic replay of customer prompt mix, p95/p99 measured over 10k requests.
````

Maya: OK timelines: Jorge + Sam produce content by tomorrow noon, Priya + Aditi polish messaging by tomorrow 5pm, design handoff Thu AM, targeting webinar follow-up email next Tue.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 artifact link when available — https://redwood.example.com/artifacts/soc2 (manual link placeholder).

Jorge: On it. I'll also add a quick note about automatic fallback chain: hosted -> dedicated regional -> private fallback (if configured). Keep it under one sentence.

Priya: Drafting now. Will use a short testimonial quote placeholder: "Saved X% latency/cost vs building in-house" — dev friendly.

Aditi: Also add a one-liner on observability: "per-route latency & token cost breakdown" — customers like that.

Maya: Great. If nobody objects, I'll mark this as the canonical field brief for secure deploys and use as the downloadable asset for webinar registration. Any blockers?

Sam: No blockers. Will upload numbers + appendix as a GDoc link by EOD.

Jorge: No blockers. Will commit first draft to the marketing board.

Priya: No blockers.

Maya: Perfect — thanks team :rocket:
